subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Redwood demo follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com>, Bob Miller <bob.miller@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo + security next steps

Hi Alice / Bob -

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard from your side:
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + de-identified embeddings for search across your EHR exports.
- Data sources: Epic extracts to S3 (nightly), an internal RDS for metadata, and an embeddings store we would host/configure.
- Key decision criteria: latency under 300ms for single-turn summarization, ability to keep PII off Redwood-hosted logs, and SOC2 + penetration test evidence.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Security kickoff - please share the right security/legal/procurement contacts and any vendor security questionnaire you want us to fill out. We can kick off a short (30-45m) session to walk through scope and provide evidence.
2) Stakeholder mapping - who is the economic buyer (for budgeting), the procurement contact, and the lead for privacy/legal? Bob / Alice, can you confirm?
3) Systems in scope - confirm whether the initial scope is just the S3 exports + embeddings store or if we should include live EHR connections (Epic) for the pilot.

I'm attaching our latest SOC2 report and a short security one-pager. I can have Rishi (security lead) and Dylan (solutions engineer) join the kickoff to answer technical questions.

Proposed time: Thu 7/1 or Fri 7/2, 10-11am PT - let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(650) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf, security-onepager.pdf

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Miller <bob.miller@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + security next steps

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the concise summary and the SOC2 - helpful. Quick answers below and attached are our initial questionnaire responses and a network topology image to help scope the conversation.

Stakeholders: 
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Bob Miller (VP of Clinical Ops) <bob.miller@acmehealth.com>
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com (cc'd) - please loop in any vendor setup requirements.
- Legal / Privacy: legal@acmehealth.com (cc'd) - they will drive contract & DPA review.
- Security reviewer: Jaime Torres (jaime.torres@acmehealth.com) - may join the kickoff.

Systems in initial scope:
- Nightly Epic exports (S3 bucket) - primary for the pilot
- Embeddings store (we expect Redwood to host/configure)
- Metadata DB (RDS) - read-only for enrichment

We are not planning to do live Epic API writes for the pilot (that would be a later phase).

Attached: Acme_Health_Security_Questionnaire_Q2_2026.pdf, network_topology_v1.png, acme-initial-questionnaire-responses.xlsx

Proposed kickoff: Thu 07/01 10:00am PT works for us - Jaime from security will attend, and legal wants to sit in for the first 15-20m.

Best,
Alice
Product Manager, Clinical Search | Acme Health
alice.chen@acmehealth.com

From: procurement@acmehealth.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo + security next steps

Marissa / Rishi -

Procurement here. For vendor onboarding we will need:
1) Vendor Contact(s) and W-9 / tax info
2) Master Services Agreement (MSA) / redlines - legal@acmehealth.com will send edits
3) Initial pricing sheet and an estimated SOW for the pilot (1-3 months)
4) Any additional compliance docs (pen test, SOC2 scope) - we saw the SOC2, please include the scope page and any penetration test summary if available.

Please provide items 1-3 prior to contract review. We can attend the kickoff to understand scope.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com>, Bob Miller <bob.miller@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security kickoff - proposed scope & attendees

Hi Alice / team -

Thanks for sending the questionnaire and topology. I pulled together an initial kickoff plan and attendee list so we can make the 07/01 meeting productive.

Proposed agenda (30-45m):
- 0-5m: Introductions & goals (Marissa / Alice)
- 5-20m: Scope & architecture review (Dylan to walk through network diagram and data flows)
- 20-35m: Evidence & controls (Rishi to cover SOC2 scope, logging, retention, and access controls)
- 35-45m: Next steps: procurement documents, SSO/KMS integration, timeline for pen test / VAPT evidence

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (AE)
- Rishi Malhotra (Security Lead)
- Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer)
- Stephanie Nguyen (Customer Success) - procurement/ops liaison

We will bring the following artifacts to the call:
- redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (full report)
- pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (high level)
- initial answers to Acme questionnaire (we'll pre-fill and share a copy)

Systems in scope (confirming what Alice noted):
- S3 nightly Epic exports (ingest path)
- Embeddings store (hosted by Redwood for the pilot)
- Read-only access to metadata RDS for enrichment

Open questions we want to confirm on the call:
- Desired data retention policy for embeddings & logs (default is 90 days, configurable)
- Whether Acme requires customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest or if Redwood KMS is acceptable for pilot
- Any IP/data residency constraints beyond US region

Marissa will send the calendar invite for Thu 07/01 10:00am PT and include a short pre-read (questionnaire + topology + SOC2). If Thu works for everyone we will lock it; otherwise we can shift to Fri 07/02 AM PT.

Thanks - looking forward to the kickoff.
Rishi
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Marissa / Rishi -

Thanks - Thu 07/01 10:00am PT is confirmed. Jaime (security) and a member of legal will join for the first 20 minutes. Procurement asked that you please upload the W-9 and an initial pricing / SOW stub before EOD Wednesday so they can start internal routing.

Also: legal wants high-level answers on logs retention and whether we support customer-managed KMS for the embeddings store. If you can include those in the pre-read that will speed the contract review.

See you on Thursday.

Best,
Alice
